name: Fig
notes:
### Video player
- **Download** videos, streams too, in the quality you pick.
- Hold for 2× speed, AirPlay, pinch to fill the screen, chapters on the timeline.
- Fine scrubbing, Resume from where you left off, Loop and A–B repeat.
- Audio Boost and Night Mode; caption timing and your own subtitle files.
- Sleep Timer (also in the reader).

### Privacy
- **HTTPS-Only Mode**, Global Privacy Control, cookie notices blocked.
- Forget This Site, Clear on Quit, password breach check, Advanced Tracking Protection.
- Private and temporary tabs stay private: covered in the app switcher, no background playback.

### Accessibility
- Always Allow Zoom, Minimum Font Size, Website Colors, automatic captions.
- Follows Reduce Motion; Listen to Page; OpenDyslexic font.

### Downloads
- A notification when a download finishes, and downloaded videos play in the player.

### Fixes
- Sites like Canvas stay signed in after Fruitfox restarts.
- Panopto captions, and captions a site draws itself, show at the bottom in your caption style.
- The player's menus no longer flash or refuse to scroll, and the player closes properly when a private tab locks.

beta.name: Grape
beta.notes:
### Apple devices
- **Handoff** between your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- **Widgets:** Search, Favorites and Reading List; Lock Screen and Control Center buttons.
- **Siri and Shortcuts:** new tabs, search, open pages, Reader, Translate, Send Page, Sleep Timer and more.
- Read-aloud on the Lock Screen, AirPods and Apple Watch.
- Notification buttons, Spotlight bookmarks, Focus filters.

### Improved
- **Renewal reminder** before Fruitfox expires, and the Renew By date in Settings.
- Release names: this one is **Grape**.
